review.imagery: Ten phase-specific renders were visually reviewed. Seven current developer-gallery scenes and three native brochure views cover the exterior, lobby, arrival, pool, living room and bedroom. The original day exterior supplies the card and hero. Stock people, broader-city photographs and duplicated brochure scenes are excluded. No dated construction photograph was established. Cards carry no badges.
review.floorPlans: Six residence drawings and two amenity sheets retain the original position keys and notices. Numerical unit areas are not printed. One-bedroom brochure layouts are shown alongside the studio and two-bedroom types currently featured online. Confirm current availability and contractual areas. Every complete sheet on physical brochure pages 23–30 was individually reviewed. The eight-page REMAPP-hosted pack reproduces those sheets and adds no distinct drawing, so duplicate choices are excluded. Unit numbers and amenity legend numbers are not treated as measurements. Six home drawings retain their exact phase-specific keys.
review.location: The full physical brochure map on page 10 and all seven destination ranges were visually reviewed. The primary page identifies Dubai Industrial City DIC 4 and publishes 24.874093995697685, 55.04245181048903. A source-hashed receipt retains the full coordinate and six-place conversion. The point remains project vicinity, with entrance unverified.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, original brochure and branded broker-hosted packs retain original bytes, dates and SHA-256 receipts. Image source URLs and original physical-page links are preserved. Existing protected identity, text research, commercial terms and source discrepancies are unchanged.

unavailable: Numerical unit-area schedules, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established. Final unit availability, contractual size and specifications require developer confirmation.
